subject: Renewal: consumption swing guard + credits proposal
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@fastfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal: consumption swing guard + credits proposal

Sarah —

Thanks again for the candid conversation earlier. Per our renewal timeline, FastFin's annual commitment will come up in March and you mentioned two priorities: predictability for unit pricing and flexibility for variable monthly usage as you scale pilots.

High level ask from your side: a short-term price hold + credits to buffer month-to-month swings while you ramp usage. We can distill that into a proposal; before I draft something for legal, can you confirm two things:
1) Target committed monthly token equivalent you want covered (ballpark is fine).  
2) Whether AP approves quarterly invoicing or needs monthly invoices.

Cc'ing Marissa (AE) and Ben (Renewals) who will own the proposal. I'll aim to circulate a draft by Friday.

—Logan
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

Attachment: none
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@fastfin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, FastFin Legal <legal@fastfin.com>
Date: 2027-02-11T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: consumption swing guard + credits proposal

Logan —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Two clarifications:
• Committed monthly target: right now we're forecasting ~2.5M tokens/mo by Q3, but for the first 3 months post-renewal we expect heavy variance (0.8x–1.6x).
• Invoicing: AP prefers monthly invoicing but can do quarterly if it helps with credit application — I need to confirm final approval with our finance lead.

Looping in Legal since we'll need the short-term price hold and swing guard language to be explicitly called out in amendments. Ben/Marissa — looking forward to the draft.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sr. Product Ops | FastFin
sarah.nguyen@fastfin.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@fastfin.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-12T15:26:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal: consumption swing guard + credits proposal

Sarah —

Attached is a draft proposal (PDF) and a short mutual action plan (XLSX) that lays out the timelines. Key points in the draft: 

• Term length: 12 months (renewal effective 2027-03-01).
• Price hold: Base unit price locked for first 6 months post-renewal; review at month 7 tied to committed volume attainment.
• Commit change: Increase committed tokens from current 1.8M/mo to 2.2M/mo (20% uplift); unused committed units convert into credits applied to future invoices within the 12-month term.
• Consumption swing guard: +-15% monthly buffer around committed tokens. Variance beyond buffer receives a credit at 50% of overage rate for the first 3 billing cycles.
• Onboarding/discount credit: One-time $50,000 credit applied on the first invoice after renewal to offset migration/ops costs.
• Invoice cadence: default monthly invoicing; option to consolidate to quarterly if AP confirms.

Open items we flagged for legal: exact language for the swing guard, credit caps, and auditing/measuring usage. If Legal is fine with simple quantification, we can lock the terms and route DocuSign.

Attachments: 2027-02-12_FastFin_Renewal_Proposal.pdf; mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Next step: can you confirm AP invoice cadence and whether the $50k one-time credit is acceptable? If yes, Ben and I will move to redlines with legal and prep DocuSign.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@fastfin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: FastFin Legal <legal@fastfin.com>, Accounting FastFin <acct@fastfin.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: consumption swing guard + credits proposal

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear draft. A few items from our side:
1) Accounting prefers monthly invoices; they can accept credits applied on subsequent invoices but need a short reconciliation window and a line item describing the credit.
2) Legal has a couple of small redlines on the swing guard definition and audit rights; they asked to see the exact metric calculation (how tokens mapped, UTC vs local time windows).
3) The $50k onboarding credit is acceptable pending final approval from Finance — copying our AP lead.

Can you upload the PDF to DocuSign and include the metric appendix for how usage will be measured? If you can get that over by Wednesday we can turn the DocuSign within the week.

Thanks — looping Accounting and Legal to track next steps.

—Sarah

Subject: RE: Renewal: consumption swing guard + credits proposal — next steps

Sarah / team —

Appreciate the quick review. Marissa — please: 1) upload the proposal to DocuSign with the metric appendix and Legal redlines tracked; 2) set invoice cadence to monthly by default; and 3) include a credit line item that maps $50,000 onboarding credit to invoice #1.

Priyom — can you schedule the capacity uplift for 2027-03-01 and confirm we have the monitoring/alerts in place for the first 90 days so we can validate the swing guard behavior? A short smoke test runbook would be great.

Once Legal signs off and DocuSign returns, Ben and I will finalize the amendment and issue an internal kickoff. Targeting DocuSign completion by 2027-02-23.

Thanks everyone,
—Logan
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference
